request.style: English, uptempo gospel, full gospel choir with soaring choir leads, Hammond organ, piano, bass, drums, tambourine, hand claps, celebratory, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was dead in my trespasses, I was lying in the grave
I had nothing I could offer and no strength that I could save
But God, who is rich in mercy, out of love so deep and wide
Made us alive together with Christ, he raised us at his side

[Chorus]
For by grace you have been saved through faith
And this is not from yourselves
It is the gift of God
Not from works, so that no one may boast

[Verse]
He raised us up together and he seated us with him
So the riches of his kindness shine through every age to come
We are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works
Which God prepared beforehand so that we would walk in them

[Chorus]
For by grace you have been saved through faith
And this is not from yourselves
It is the gift of God
Not from works, so that no one may boast

[Bridge]
But God, who is rich in mercy
Because of the great love with which he loved us
Made us alive together with Christ
By grace you have been saved

[Outro]
It is the gift of God
By grace you have been saved
